page.title: The Jester Is a Strategy, Not a Costume
page.meta_description: Explore the Jester archetype through humor, satire, verbal wit, visual personality, and memorable brand campaigns.
page.lede: A good jester does more than crack jokes. It notices the absurd, changes the angle, and makes a serious idea easier to confront.

editorial_disclaimer: Brand archetypes are interpretive frameworks for storytelling and positioning, not scientific personality diagnoses. Brand examples describe selected campaigns, not verified current strategies or endorsements.

sections.title: Why the Jester Works
sections.intro: The promise is a change in emotional temperature: less ceremony, more curiosity, and a chance to see an ordinary problem differently.
points: Give the audience a reason to participate, not just observe.
Let humor reveal a useful idea rather than bury it.

sections.title: A Grin With a Spine
sections.intro: Jester humor can be joyful, provocative, satirical, or quietly wise. It gets stronger when play serves a point.
points: Challenge convention without mistaking cruelty for wit.
Keep the human truth visible behind the performance.

sections.title: How a Jester Sounds
sections.intro: Write like an observant person with good timing, not a machine trying to manufacture punchlines.
points: Tilt the framing, rather than adding a random joke.
Finish with something clear enough to act on.

sections.title: How a Jester Looks
sections.intro: Unexpected color, irregular imagery, expressive type, and playful compositions can signal character, but the interface still needs contrast and legibility.
points: Use contrast to make surprise intentional.
Prefer a distinctive visual system over random effects.
Keep accessible reading order and reliable interactions.

interpretive_lenses.name: Playful Entertainer
interpretive_lenses.description: Uses shared amusement and audience participation to make ordinary moments lighter.

interpretive_lenses.name: Absurdist
interpretive_lenses.description: Escalates the ordinary into the improbable to expose how strange familiar conventions already are.

interpretive_lenses.name: Satirical Challenger
interpretive_lenses.description: Points humor toward assumptions, institutions, and contradictions instead of easy targets.

interpretive_lenses.name: Provocateur
interpretive_lenses.description: Uses controlled friction to make an overlooked issue hard to ignore.

interpretive_lenses.name: Perspective Shifter
interpretive_lenses.description: Changes roles and framing so the audience can reconsider what it assumed was obvious.

interpretive_lenses_note: These are Jester Quotes editorial lenses synthesized from the cited material, not an established five-part classification.

design_principles.title: Surprise with a reason
design_principles.application: Use one deliberate visual disruption at a time.

design_principles.title: Typography with character
design_principles.application: Pair expressive display treatments with a readable body face.

design_principles.title: A mark made by a person
design_principles.application: Use irregular icon treatments when they improve recognition.

design_principles.title: Never sacrifice usability for mischief
design_principles.application: Preserve contrast, keyboard access, navigation clarity, and reduced-motion behavior.
